== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Houjix (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Houjix]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100665 source], Japanese ESB Two-Player photograph.

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>e7da772f051858948bf9c7d32e7999757cb5c45e42a825cd516cacfa9911ef9d</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
